title: RepoSnapshot Invoke-IgnoreFilter Output
$comment: Dictionary-valued structure keyed by NodePath. Produced by Invoke-IgnoreFilter — joins ignore engine compiled output with crawler Files, stamps RelativePath, and filters in a single fused pass. Pruned branches absent. BFS order not guaranteed (dictionary iteration); NodeDepth retained for downstream ordering.
description: Output of Invoke-IgnoreFilter. Each entry is a surviving directory node with filtered Files (only non-ignored files remain). RelativePath is pre-computed on each FileEntry for downstream serialization and content processing.

CompiledIgnoreState.title: CompiledIgnoreState
CompiledIgnoreState.description: Compiled regex pair for a node's merged ignore rules. Positives = main ignore regex (match = ignore). Exceptions = negation override regex (match = un-ignore). Either may be null if no patterns of that polarity exist after reduction.

Positives.description: Compiled regex for positive ignore patterns, or null.

Exceptions.description: Compiled regex for negation (!) patterns, or null.

FileEntry.title: FileEntry
FileEntry.description: A file from the crawler's BFS, enriched with RelativePath during RunJoin(). RelativePath is forward-slash normalized, relative to the snapshot root — computed once here for all downstream use (filtering, serialization).

AbsolutePath.description: Absolute path, forward-slash normalized. Retained for file I/O during content processing (Phase 6).

RelativePath.description: Path relative to snapshot root, forward-slash normalized. Computed once during RunJoin() via [IO.Path]::GetRelativePath(). Used by filtering (.Where() regex match) and artifact serialization.

JoinedNode.title: JoinedNode
JoinedNode.description: A surviving directory node after join. Carries the crawler's node identity + Files, plus the ignore engine's compiled regex state. CompiledIgnore and ExecutiveOverride are mutually exclusive pathways.

NodePath.description: Path relative to snapshot root, forward-slash. '' for root, trailing '/' for non-root.

AbsolutePath.description: Absolute path to this directory, forward-slash normalized, trailing '/' required.

Files.description: Files directly in this directory, enriched with RelativePath.

CompiledIgnore.description: Compiled ignore state from normal pipeline, or null when ExecutiveOverride is active.

ExecutiveOverride.description: Compiled regex for executive override bypass (match = KEEP), or null when normal pipeline is active.
